prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1354; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision described below, which occurred while your insured was changing lanes and sideswiped our client's vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries that are the subject of ongoing medical treatment, and we expect a claim for damages to follow.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly. If your insured or any representative of your company wishes to discuss the claim, they should do so through counsel.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage policy limits applicable to your insured's coverage for this loss, along with a copy of the declarations page.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision, including the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, dashcam or telematics footage, and any other materials in your possession or control. Please confirm in writing that these items will be retained.
